title: SLOOP: a guided tour
summary: A tour of SLOOP 2.8.5, the live groovebox firmware: the four tracks, sounds and drum kits, ghost and hard hits, looping by playing, note repeat, the step sequencer and DRUMS screen, your own samples in USR1-USR4, key and chords, punch-in effects, sections and saving.
author: Claude Code draft 2026-11-15

steps.title: Welcome to SLOOP
steps.text: SLOOP turns the FM-1 into a four-track groovebox you play live: three synths and a drum machine. This is the TRACKS screen: tempo, transport and each track's sound and steps. Tap HOME to come back here (on TRACKS, HOME opens the visualiser; HOME again closes it). Hold HOME for the menu.

steps.title: Four tracks
steps.text: ALGORITHM picks the track you play, record and edit, on every screen: 1 blue, 2 green, 3 yellow (synths, sharing 8 voices) and 4 orange, the drum machine. The screen takes the selected track's colour. KNOB1 to KNOB4 set what the four dials at the bottom of the screen show.

await.hint: Turn ALGORITHM to pick another track

steps.title: Play and pick a sound
steps.text: The keys play the selected track. OCT- and OCT+ shift the octave; both together reset it. PRESETS picks the track's sound from 153 factory sounds, browsed by kind (bass, keys, pads, leads...), then your 32 user presets. MASTER is the volume.

await.hint: Turn PRESETS and play a key

steps.title: The drum track and its KIT
steps.text: On track 4 the 16 white keys are 16 drum sounds: F3 kick, G3 kick 2, A3 snare, B3 clap, C4 hat, D4 open hat... to G5 cowbell. A black key plays the white key on its left. PRESETS picks the kit: 37 kits (808, 909, BOOMBAP...), then USR1-USR4, USR3+4 and SYN1-SYN4.

steps.title: Ghost and hard hits
steps.text: The keys have no velocity, so on the drum track every hit gets a level: hold OCT- while you hit for GHOST notes, OCT+ for HARD ones; plain hits are NORM. Softer hits sound darker as well as quieter, and the level is recorded with the hit.

steps.title: Record a loop by playing
steps.text: On an empty project press REC, then play a beat freely: no click, no tempo. Press REC on the "1" after your last bar: the loop closes, its length sets the tempo, and it plays. Press REC again while it plays to record on top (overdub). PLAY starts and stops all four tracks.

await.hint: Press REC, play a beat, then REC again on the 1

steps.title: The REC screen, clear and undo
steps.text: While REC is armed, the knobs set MODE (KNOB1: free or tempo), LENGTH (KNOB2: 1, 2 or 4 bars), START (KNOB3: first note or a count-in) and QUANT (KNOB4). Hold REC about 2 s to clear the selected track. EDIT + OCT- is undo, EDIT + OCT+ redo.

steps.title: Note repeat
steps.text: Hold ARP and hold a key: it repeats on the grid, locked to the tempo, until you let go (a hat roll on C4). ARP + KNOB1 sets the RATE, 1/8 to 1/64. While recording, rolls are written as ratchets. Tap ARP for the arpeggiator's pages instead.

steps.title: The step sequencer
steps.text: Hold SEQ: the 16 white keys become steps 1-16 (lit ones play). Press an empty step to set it, a set one to clear it. SEQ + KNOB1 picks the sound or note, KNOB2 the DIV, KNOB3 the swing, KNOB4 the length (up to 64 steps). SEQ + OCT- / OCT+ change the page of 16.

await.hint: Hold SEQ and press C4 to set step 5

steps.title: Shape a step
steps.text: Hold SEQ and hold a step: KNOB2 sets its level (drums) or velocity (synths), KNOB3 a ratchet x1-x4, KNOB4 a nudge off the grid. PRESETS adds a parameter lock and ALGORITHM picks its parameter. OCT+ cycles the fill condition; OCT- clears nudge, locks and condition.

steps.title: The DRUMS screen
steps.text: With the drum track on TRACKS, tap SEQ (or EDIT) for the DRUMS grid: KNOB1 the sound, KNOB2 the step, KNOB3 a hit, KNOB4 its level; the white keys are that sound's steps. Tap again for the kit page and the sound page (tune and decay per sound). HOME goes back.

steps.title: Your own samples: USR1-USR4
steps.text: Four user slots, USR1-USR4, hold about 7.4 s each (22 kHz mono). You fill them from SLOOP's web editor over USB: its Samples page (up to 16 WAVs, or CHOP) or Drum kit page. Play a slot as a kit (PRESETS on track 4: USR1-USR4, or USR3+4, about 15 s) or with a synth's SAMPLE engine.

steps.title: Key and chords
steps.text: Hold SCL (SLOOP calls it SEL) and press a key to set the key of the song for all three synths. On a synth track, SCL + KNOB1 sets CHORD (TRIAD, 7TH, 9TH...): every white key then plays a chord of the key, one finger each. KNOB2 is the scale, KNOB3 KEYS, KNOB4 transpose.

await.hint: Hold SCL and press D4 to set the key to D

steps.title: Punch-in effects
steps.text: Hold FX and hold a key, white or black, for one of 27 punch-in effects on the whole mix: loops, stutter, reverse, tape stop, filter sweeps and more. Still holding FX, KNOB1 is the master filter, KNOB2 DUST, KNOB3 DUCK, KNOB4 the track's filter. Best while it plays.

steps.title: Sections and the song
steps.text: Hold SAVE: white keys 5-8 (C4-F4) save the loop into sections A-D, keys 1-4 (F3-B3) play them from the next bar; tap several while held for a chain. Key 13 (D5) switches loop / song, key 14 (E5) records the song as you play. Stopped for 2.5 s, SLOOP autosaves.

steps.title: Save a sound and learn more
steps.text: Tap SAVE on a page other than TRACKS for the SAVE pages: on USER, KNOB1 picks a slot (1-32) and KNOB4 saves, turned twice (GO). TOOLS has NEW. Keep several songs as web editor backups. More: the guide at github.com/isod89/sloop-fm1 (GUIDE.md).
